import json
H,W=30,24
g=[[4]*W for _ in range(H)]
# Top-left 7 field with 3 pattern
for r in range(2,7):
    for c in range(9,16): g[r][c]=7
for r in range(3,6):
    for c in [10,11,13,14]: g[r][c]=3
# top-right 7 frame / 3 center
for r in range(1,5):
    for c in range(19,23): g[r][c]=7
for r in [2,3]:
    for c in [20,21]: g[r][c]=3
# Panel 1: rows 13-20, side borders 3, fill 7
for r in range(13,21):
    for c in range(W): g[r][c]=7
    g[r][0]=g[r][23]=3
# Panel 2: rows 22-28, side borders 9, fill 3
for r in range(22,29):
    for c in range(W): g[r][c]=3
    g[r][0]=g[r][23]=9
# Encode 7-patterns in panel 1, bottom aligned
for r in range(16,21):
    for c in range(9,16): g[r][c]=3 if (r in (16,20) or c in (9,15) or c==12) else 7
# Explicitly use mapped source pattern to avoid assumptions for inner cells
for dr, srcvals in enumerate([
    [7]*7,
    [7,3,3,7,3,3,7],
    [7,3,3,7,3,3,7],
    [7,3,3,7,3,3,7],
    [7]*7]):
    rr=16+dr
    for dc,v in enumerate(srcvals): g[rr][9+dc]=3 if v==7 else 7
# top-right pattern, bottom aligned in panel 1
for dr, srcvals in enumerate([[7]*4,[7,3,3,7],[7,3,3,7],[7]*4]):
    for dc,v in enumerate(srcvals): g[17+dr][19+dc]=3 if v==7 else 7
# Encode each 3 component in panel 2, bottom aligned
for r in range(26,29):
    for c in [10,11,13,14]: g[r][c]=9
for r in range(27,29):
    for c in [20,21]: g[r][c]=9
print(json.dumps(g))
